raw_segments.text: Caesar, most probable that so she died, for her physician tells me she hath pursued conclusions
infinite of easy ways to die.
Take up her bed, and bear her women from the monument.
She shall be buried by her antony.
No grave upon the earth shall clip in it a pair so famous.
High events as these strike those that make them, and their story is no less in pity than
his glory which brought them to be lamented.
Our army shall in solemn show attend this funeral, and then to Rome.
Come, Dallebella, see high order in this great solemnity.
